examples.en: Scientists speculate that the island once had a larger population.
examples.zh: 科學家推測這座島以前的人口比較多。

examples.en: People began to speculate about why the store closed so suddenly.
examples.zh: 大家開始猜測這家店為什麼突然關門。

examples.en: Some investors speculate in land to make a quick profit.
examples.zh: 有些投資人炒作土地來賺取快錢。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a glass sphere in science class.
examples.zh: 老師在自然課上拿了一個玻璃球體給我們看。

examples.en: Music plays an important role in the sphere of education.
examples.zh: 音樂在教育領域中扮演重要的角色。

examples.en: Her sphere of influence at the company keeps growing.
examples.zh: 她在公司的影響範圍持續擴大。

examples.en: Sitting up straight is good for your spine.
examples.zh: 坐直對你的脊椎有好處。

examples.en: The doctor checked the bones in my spine.
examples.zh: 醫師檢查了我脊椎的骨頭。

examples.en: The title is printed on the spine of the book.
examples.zh: 書名印在書背上。

examples.en: Use a wet sponge to clean the table.
examples.zh: 用濕的海綿把桌子擦乾淨。

examples.en: This sponge soaks up water very quickly.
examples.zh: 這塊海綿吸水吸得很快。

examples.en: I bought a new sponge for washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 我買了一塊新的菜瓜布來洗碗。

examples.en: Please sponge the spilled juice off the floor.
examples.zh: 請把灑在地上的果汁擦掉。

examples.en: She sponged the baby's face with warm water.
examples.zh: 她用溫水幫寶寶擦臉。

examples.en: He tried to sponge a free lunch from his classmates.
examples.zh: 他想向同學蹭一頓免費的午餐。

examples.en: The concert was held with the sponsorship of a local bank.
examples.zh: 這場音樂會由當地一家銀行贊助舉辦。

examples.en: The school received sponsorship from several companies.
examples.zh: 學校獲得了幾家公司的贊助。

examples.en: Our team is looking for sponsorship for the next season.
examples.zh: 我們的球隊正在為下一季尋求贊助。

examples.en: Please write your spouse's name on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫配偶的姓名。

examples.en: Employees may bring a spouse to the year-end party.
examples.zh: 員工可以攜帶配偶參加尾牙。

examples.en: Her spouse works as a nurse at the city hospital.
examples.zh: 她的配偶在市立醫院擔任護理師。

examples.en: The school's basketball squad won the final game.
examples.zh: 學校的籃球隊贏得了決賽。

examples.en: A rescue squad arrived at the scene within ten minutes.
examples.zh: 救援小隊在十分鐘內抵達現場。

examples.en: The coach announced the squad for the weekend match.
examples.zh: 教練公布了週末比賽的出賽名單。

examples.en: Don't put the bread under the heavy bags, or you'll squash it.
examples.zh: 別把麵包放在重袋子下面，不然會被壓扁。

examples.en: We all squashed into the small elevator.
examples.zh: 我們全都擠進了那部小電梯。

examples.en: She squashed the empty box before throwing it away.
examples.zh: 她把空盒子壓扁後才丟掉。

examples.en: My uncle plays squash every Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我叔叔每個星期六早上都打壁球。

examples.en: We had roasted squash for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了烤南瓜。

examples.en: There is a squash court near the sports center.
examples.zh: 運動中心附近有一座壁球場。

examples.en: The little boy squatted down to look at the ant.
examples.zh: 小男孩蹲下來看那隻螞蟻。

examples.en: You should squat with your back straight.
examples.zh: 你深蹲的時候背要挺直。

examples.en: We squatted by the river to wash our hands.
examples.zh: 我們蹲在河邊洗手。

examples.en: The farmer lives in a squat house near the field.
examples.zh: 農夫住在田邊一間矮矮胖胖的房子裡。

examples.en: A squat tower stands at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 街尾有一座矮胖的塔。

examples.en: She bought a squat vase for the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 她買了一個矮胖的花瓶放在廚房餐桌上。

examples.en: The country has enjoyed political stability for many years.
examples.zh: 這個國家多年來享有政治穩定。

examples.en: A wide base gives the table more stability.
examples.zh: 寬大的底座讓桌子更穩固。

examples.en: Many people look for job stability when they choose a career.
examples.zh: 許多人選擇職業時會尋求工作的穩定性。

examples.en: There is a stack of books on my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌上有一疊書。

examples.en: She put a stack of plates on the counter.
examples.zh: 她把一疊盤子放在流理台上。

examples.en: A stack of mail was waiting for us when we got home.
examples.zh: 我們到家時，有一疊信件在等著我們。

examples.en: Please stack the chairs after the meeting.
examples.zh: 開完會後請把椅子堆疊起來。

examples.en: The workers stacked the boxes against the wall.
examples.zh: 工人把箱子堆放在牆邊。

examples.en: He stacks his toys neatly on the shelf.
examples.zh: 他把玩具整齊地堆在架子上。

examples.en: There is a coffee stain on my shirt.
examples.zh: 我的襯衫上有一塊咖啡漬。

examples.en: She used lemon juice to remove the stain.
examples.zh: 她用檸檬汁去除汙漬。

examples.en: One mistake left a stain on his record.
examples.zh: 一次失誤讓他的紀錄留下了汙點。

examples.en: Red wine can stain a white carpet.
examples.zh: 紅酒會弄髒白色地毯。

examples.en: Be careful not to stain your uniform with ink.
examples.zh: 小心別讓墨水弄髒你的制服。

examples.en: The juice stained the tablecloth.
examples.zh: 果汁在桌巾上留下了汙漬。

examples.en: We bought fresh fruit at a stall in the night market.
examples.zh: 我們在夜市的一個攤位買了新鮮水果。

examples.en: The stall sells hot soy milk every morning.
examples.zh: 這個攤位每天早上都賣熱豆漿。

examples.en: The horse stayed in its stall during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴風雨期間，馬待在牠的馬廄隔間裡。

examples.en: The car stalled at the traffic light.
examples.zh: 車子在紅綠燈前熄火了。

examples.en: Don't stall; just tell us the answer.
examples.zh: 別拖延了，直接告訴我們答案吧。

examples.en: Talks stalled because the two sides could not agree.
examples.zh: 由於雙方無法達成共識，談判陷入停滯。

examples.en: The mayor took a clear stance on public transportation.
examples.zh: 市長對大眾運輸表明了明確的立場。

examples.en: Our school has a strict stance against cheating.
examples.zh: 我們學校對作弊抱持嚴格的立場。

examples.en: Keep your feet apart in a wide stance when you swing.
examples.zh: 揮桿時雙腳要張開，站穩姿勢。

examples.en: The loud noise startled the baby.
examples.zh: 巨大的聲響嚇了寶寶一跳。

examples.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to startle you.
examples.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意嚇你的。

examples.en: A sudden knock at the door startled everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 突然的敲門聲讓房間裡的每個人都嚇了一跳。

examples.en: The report includes a lot of statistical data.
examples.zh: 這份報告包含許多統計資料。

examples.en: She is taking a statistical analysis course this semester.
examples.zh: 她這學期正在修統計分析的課。

examples.en: The statistical results show that sales rose in March.
examples.zh: 統計結果顯示三月的銷售量上升了。

examples.en: The movie challenges the stereotype that boys can't cook.
examples.zh: 這部電影挑戰了男生不會煮飯的刻板印象。

examples.en: Teachers should help students avoid stereotypes about other cultures.
examples.zh: 老師應該幫助學生避免對其他文化產生刻板印象。

examples.en: It is a common stereotype that all tourists love taking photos.
examples.zh: 所有遊客都愛拍照是一種常見的刻板印象。

examples.en: Don't stereotype people by the clothes they wear.
examples.zh: 別憑穿著對人抱持刻板印象。

examples.en: The ad was criticized for stereotyping older workers.
examples.zh: 這則廣告因對年長員工抱持刻板印象而受到批評。

examples.en: We should not stereotype a country based on one trip.
examples.zh: 我們不該只憑一次旅行就對一個國家抱持刻板印象。

examples.en: My grandmother makes a delicious beef stew in winter.
examples.zh: 我奶奶冬天會煮美味的燉牛肉。

examples.en: We had vegetable stew with rice for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了蔬菜燉菜配飯。

examples.en: The stew smells wonderful, so I want a second bowl.
examples.zh: 這道燉菜聞起來好香，我想再來第二碗。

examples.en: Stew the apples with a little sugar for ten minutes.
examples.zh: 把蘋果加一點糖燉十分鐘。

examples.en: He stewed the pork slowly over low heat.
examples.zh: 他用小火慢慢燉那塊豬肉。

examples.en: You can stew tomatoes to make a thick sauce.
examples.zh: 你可以燉煮番茄來做濃稠的醬汁。

examples.en: Light is a strong stimulus for plants.
examples.zh: 光對植物是強烈的刺激。

examples.en: The prize served as a stimulus for the students to study harder.
examples.zh: 這個獎品激勵學生更努力讀書。

examples.en: The government hopes lower taxes will be a stimulus to the economy.
examples.zh: 政府希望減稅能成為刺激經濟的動力。

examples.en: This phone has 128 gigabytes of storage.
examples.zh: 這支手機有 128 GB 的儲存空間。

examples.en: We keep the winter clothes in storage during summer.
examples.zh: 夏天時我們把冬季衣物收在儲藏處。

examples.en: The apartment has plenty of storage under the stairs.
examples.zh: 這間公寓的樓梯下有很多收納空間。

examples.en: Please straighten your back when you sit.
examples.zh: 坐著的時候請把背挺直。

examples.en: She straightened the pictures on the wall.
examples.zh: 她把牆上的畫扶正。

examples.en: He straightened his tie before the interview.
examples.zh: 他在面試前把領帶拉直。

examples.en: The instructions are straightforward and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 這些說明簡單明瞭，很容易照著做。

examples.en: She gave a straightforward answer to the question.
examples.zh: 她對這個問題給了坦率的回答。

examples.en: Filling out the application form is quite straightforward.
examples.zh: 填寫申請表相當簡單。

examples.en: The long trip put a strain on the whole family.
examples.zh: 這趟長途旅行讓全家人都備感壓力。

examples.en: He felt a muscle strain in his leg after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後他覺得腿部肌肉拉傷了。

examples.en: Too much work can cause mental strain.
examples.zh: 工作過多可能造成精神上的壓力。

examples.en: Don't strain your eyes by reading in the dark.
examples.zh: 別在黑暗中看書，以免傷眼睛。

examples.en: She strained her back while moving the boxes.
examples.zh: 她搬箱子時拉傷了背。

examples.en: Strain the soup before you serve it.
examples.zh: 上桌前先把湯過濾一下。

examples.en: The strap on my backpack broke this morning.
examples.zh: 我背包的背帶今天早上斷了。

examples.en: Please adjust the strap of the watch to fit your wrist.
examples.zh: 請調整錶帶，讓它符合你的手腕。

examples.en: She held the bus strap tightly with one hand.
examples.zh: 她用一隻手緊緊抓著公車的吊帶。

examples.en: Strap yourself in before the ride starts.
examples.zh: 遊樂設施開始前請繫好安全帶。

examples.en: He strapped the bike to the back of the car.
examples.zh: 他把腳踏車綁在車子後面。

examples.en: Dad strapped the baby into the car seat.
examples.zh: 爸爸把寶寶繫在汽車安全座椅上。

examples.en: The company made a strategic decision to open new stores.
examples.zh: 公司做出了開設新分店的策略性決定。

examples.en: Our team needs a strategic plan for the next year.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊需要一份明年的策略計畫。

examples.en: The port is in a strategic location near the sea route.
examples.zh: 這個港口位於海上航線附近的戰略位置。

examples.en: She has a striking red coat.
examples.zh: 她有一件引人注目的紅色外套。

examples.en: There is a striking difference between the two photos.
examples.zh: 這兩張照片之間有顯著的差異。

examples.en: The view from the top of the hill is truly striking.
examples.zh: 從山頂望出去的景色真的令人驚豔。

examples.en: The engineer found a structural problem in the old bridge.
examples.zh: 工程師發現這座舊橋有結構上的問題。

examples.en: The building needs structural repairs after the earthquake.
examples.zh: 這棟建築在地震後需要進行結構修復。

examples.en: The company announced a structural change in its sales department.
examples.zh: 公司宣布了業務部門的結構調整。

senses.zh: 絆倒；跌跌撞撞；結結巴巴

examples.en: He stumbled on the stairs and dropped his books.
examples.zh: 他在樓梯上絆了一跤，書掉了一地。

examples.en: She stumbled through her speech because she was nervous.
examples.zh: 她因為緊張，演講說得結結巴巴。

examples.en: The little girl stumbled over a toy in the dark.
examples.zh: 小女孩在黑暗中被一個玩具絆倒了。

examples.en: A stumble on the rocky path hurt his ankle.
examples.zh: 他在石子路上絆了一跤，腳踝受傷了。

examples.en: The team recovered quickly from an early stumble.
examples.zh: 球隊很快從早期的失誤中恢復過來。

examples.en: Her stumble on the stage made the audience gasp.
examples.zh: 她在舞台上絆了一跤，讓觀眾倒抽一口氣。

examples.en: This sturdy table can hold a lot of weight.
examples.zh: 這張堅固的桌子可以承受很大的重量。

examples.en: He bought a pair of sturdy boots for the hike.
examples.zh: 他為了健行買了一雙結實的靴子。

examples.en: The little boy is sturdy for his age.
examples.zh: 這個小男孩以他的年紀來說相當結實。

examples.en: Please submit your homework by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五前繳交作業。

examples.en: You can submit the form online.
examples.zh: 你可以在線上提交這份表格。

examples.en: The rebels finally submitted to the new government.
examples.zh: 叛軍最後向新政府屈服。

examples.en: Subsequent chapters explain the idea in more detail.
examples.zh: 後面的章節會更詳細地說明這個概念。

examples.en: Sales grew in subsequent years.
examples.zh: 銷售量在後來的幾年持續成長。

examples.en: Please read the first page before the subsequent ones.
examples.zh: 請先讀第一頁，再讀後面的各頁。

examples.en: The government offers a subsidy to young farmers.
examples.zh: 政府提供補助給年輕的農民。

examples.en: Students from low-income families may receive a subsidy for lunch.
examples.zh: 低收入家庭的學生可以領取午餐補助。

examples.en: The city ended the subsidy for electric scooters last year.
examples.zh: 市政府去年停止了電動機車的補助。

examples.en: The company made a substantial profit this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年賺進了可觀的利潤。

examples.en: A substantial number of students joined the club.
examples.zh: 有相當多的學生加入了這個社團。

examples.en: We had a substantial breakfast before the hike.
examples.zh: 我們在健行前吃了一頓豐盛的早餐。

examples.en: There is a subtle difference between these two colors.
examples.zh: 這兩種顏色之間有細微的差別。

examples.en: She gave him a subtle hint that it was time to go.
examples.zh: 她給了他一個微妙的暗示，表示該走了。

examples.en: The soup has a subtle flavor of ginger.
examples.zh: 這碗湯有淡淡的薑味。

examples.en: They live in a quiet suburban neighborhood.
examples.zh: 他們住在安靜的郊區社區。

examples.en: Many suburban families own two cars.
examples.zh: 許多郊區的家庭擁有兩輛車。

examples.en: We moved to a suburban area to be closer to the park.
examples.zh: 我們搬到了郊區，離公園近一點。

examples.en: The manager is looking for a successor before she retires.
examples.zh: 經理在退休前正在尋找接任者。

examples.en: The new phone is the successor to last year's model.
examples.zh: 這支新手機是去年款式的後續機種。

examples.en: Who will be the successor of the club president?
examples.zh: 誰會接任社團社長？

examples.en: We booked a suite with an ocean view.
examples.zh: 我們訂了一間有海景的套房。

examples.en: The hotel suite has a living room and two bedrooms.
examples.zh: 這間飯店套房有一間客廳和兩間臥室。

examples.en: The office suite includes a word processor and a spreadsheet program.
examples.zh: 這套辦公室軟體包含文書處理程式和試算表程式。

examples.en: It is a common superstition that the number four is unlucky.
examples.zh: 數字四不吉利是一種常見的迷信。

examples.en: My grandmother believes in many old superstitions.
examples.zh: 我奶奶相信許多古老的迷信。

examples.en: Superstition makes some people avoid walking under ladders.
examples.zh: 迷信讓有些人避免從梯子底下走過。

examples.en: Teachers supervise the students during lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐時間老師會看管學生。

examples.en: She supervises a team of ten workers.
examples.zh: 她管理一個十人的團隊。

examples.en: A parent must supervise young children at the pool.
examples.zh: 家長必須在泳池邊看管年幼的孩子。

examples.en: Young children need adult supervision near the water.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子在水邊需要大人看管。

examples.en: The students worked in the lab under the teacher's supervision.
examples.zh: 學生們在老師的督導下於實驗室裡工作。

examples.en: The new employees are working under close supervision.
examples.zh: 新進員工正在嚴密的督導下工作。

examples.en: The company reported a surplus at the end of the year.
examples.zh: 公司在年底公布了盈餘。

examples.en: The farm has a surplus of rice this season.
examples.zh: 這座農場這一季的稻米過剩。

examples.en: The city gave the surplus food to families in need.
examples.zh: 市政府把多餘的食物送給有需要的家庭。

examples.en: We donated our surplus clothes to a charity.
examples.zh: 我們把多餘的衣服捐給了慈善機構。

examples.en: The shop sells surplus goods at half price.
examples.zh: 這家店以半價出售剩餘的貨品。

examples.en: Use the surplus water to wash the car.
examples.zh: 把多餘的水拿來洗車。

examples.en: The mall uses cameras for surveillance.
examples.zh: 這間購物中心使用攝影機進行監控。

examples.en: The building is under 24-hour surveillance.
examples.zh: 這棟大樓全天候受到監控。

examples.en: Police reviewed the surveillance footage from the station.
examples.zh: 警方調閱了車站的監視影像。

examples.en: Plants need water and sunlight to sustain growth.
examples.zh: 植物需要水和陽光來維持生長。

examples.en: The old bridge cannot sustain heavy trucks.
examples.zh: 這座舊橋無法承受重型卡車。

examples.en: She sustained a minor injury during the game.
examples.zh: 她在比賽中受了輕傷。

examples.en: The city is building a sustainable transport system.
examples.zh: 這座城市正在建立永續的交通系統。

examples.en: Bamboo is a sustainable material for furniture.
examples.zh: 竹子是適合做家具的永續材料。

examples.en: We should find a sustainable way to use water.
examples.zh: 我們應該找到永續利用水資源的方法。

examples.en: Let's swap seats so you can see the screen.
examples.zh: 我們交換座位吧，這樣你就能看到螢幕。

examples.en: The two students swapped notebooks before the quiz.
examples.zh: 兩位學生在小考前互換了筆記本。

examples.en: Can I swap my shift with yours on Friday?
examples.zh: 星期五我可以和你換班嗎？

examples.en: The class held a book swap last week.
examples.zh: 班上上週舉辦了一場書籍交換活動。

examples.en: We made a quick swap of phone numbers.
examples.zh: 我們很快互換了電話號碼。

examples.en: The two teams agreed to a player swap.
examples.zh: 兩支球隊同意了球員交換。

examples.en: The dove is a symbolic bird of peace.
examples.zh: 鴿子是象徵和平的鳥類。

examples.en: The mayor made a symbolic visit to the old school.
examples.zh: 市長象徵性地拜訪了那所老學校。

examples.en: Red is a symbolic color for good luck in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，紅色是象徵好運的顏色。

examples.en: The doctor explained the syndrome to the patient's parents.
examples.zh: 醫師向病人的父母說明了這種症候群。

examples.en: Down syndrome is a condition that a child is born with.
examples.zh: 唐氏症是孩子與生俱來的一種狀況。

examples.en: Lack of sleep may lead to a tired-all-the-time syndrome.
examples.zh: 睡眠不足可能導致一直覺得很累的症候群。

examples.en: We need to tackle this problem as a team.
examples.zh: 我們需要以團隊合作來處理這個問題。

examples.en: The city is trying to tackle traffic jams.
examples.zh: 市政府正試圖解決塞車問題。

examples.en: The player tackled his opponent and took the ball.
examples.zh: 那位球員擒抱對手並搶下了球。

examples.en: My uncle keeps his fishing tackle in the garage.
examples.zh: 我叔叔把他的釣具放在車庫裡。

examples.en: The coach praised him for a clean tackle.
examples.zh: 教練稱讚他那次乾淨的擒抱。

examples.en: Bring all your fishing tackle to the lake.
examples.zh: 把你所有的釣具帶去湖邊。

examples.en: The coach changed his tactic in the second half.
examples.zh: 教練在下半場改變了戰術。

examples.en: Offering discounts is a common sales tactic.
examples.zh: 提供折扣是常見的銷售手法。

examples.en: Her tactic was to stay calm and listen first.
examples.zh: 她的策略是保持冷靜並先聽對方說。

examples.en: My earphones were in a tangle at the bottom of the bag.
examples.zh: 我的耳機纏成一團，躺在包包底部。

examples.en: She brushed the tangle out of her long hair.
examples.zh: 她把長髮上的糾結梳開。

examples.en: The room was a tangle of wires and cables.
examples.zh: 房間裡電線和纜線糾纏成一團。

examples.en: The kitten tangled itself in the yarn.
examples.zh: 小貓把自己纏進毛線裡了。

examples.en: Strong wind can tangle your hair.
examples.zh: 強風會把你的頭髮吹亂打結。

examples.en: Fishing lines tangle easily if you don't store them properly.
examples.zh: 釣魚線如果沒有妥善收好，很容易打結。
